name: medStyleClass
description: Target selector (@next, @prev, @parent, @grandparent, or CSS selector) controlled by [medStyleClass].

name: enterFromClass
description: CSS class added before the enter transition starts.

name: enterActiveClass
description: CSS class applied during the active enter transition.

name: enterToClass
description: CSS class applied when the enter transition finishes.

name: leaveFromClass
description: CSS class added before the leave transition starts.

name: leaveActiveClass
description: CSS class applied during the active leave transition.

name: leaveToClass
description: CSS class applied when the leave transition finishes.

name: hideOnOutsideClick
description: Automatically hides or leaves the target element when clicking outside it.

name: hideOnEscape
description: Automatically hides or leaves the target element when pressing Escape.

name: toggleClass
description: CSS class toggled on the target element instead of enter/leave transitions.

name: trigger
description: DOM interaction event that triggers the style class transition or toggle.
